description: Validate a quote draft against the native questionnaire and return missing/invalid questions and the canonical consent prompt. Before asking the user again, inspect any prior explicit instruction in the SAME conversation and supply its EXACT verbatim text as prior_user_message. The server indicates whether that prior statement is explicit enough to reuse; never infer consent from a generic quote search. Read-only and no partner side effects.

prior_user_message.description: Optional exact quote of the user's own prior instruction from this same conversation, never an LLM paraphrase, boolean or speculative assent. Server assesses whether it already authorizes AssurancesLabs to register this request and contact the user.

name: prepare_quote_request
